builder = r'''
import numpy as np
pre='bert.encoder.layer.'
def build(g_attn, g_out, s=0.1, B=10.0, c=1000.0, A=None, D=None, center=None, save=True, carry=True):
    """g_attn/g_out: arrays len 12 of LN gains for D dims (index = layer)."""
    E = {}
    def get(n): 
        if n not in E: E[n] = base(n).copy()
        return E[n]
    W2_0 = base(pre+'0.output.dense.weight')
    N = np.argsort(np.linalg.norm(W2_0,axis=0))[:len(D)]
    if carry:
        # layer 0
        get(pre+'0.attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')[D]=0; get(pre+'0.attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')[D]=0
        Wi = get(pre+'0.intermediate.dense.weight'); bi = get(pre+'0.intermediate.dense.bias')
        Wi[N,:] = s*A.T; bi[N] = B
        Wo = get(pre+'0.output.dense.weight'); bo = get(pre+'0.output.dense.bias')
        Wo[D,:]=0; Wo[:,N]=0; Wo[D[:,None],N[None,:]] = np.eye(len(D)); bo[D] = -B - s*center
        get(pre+'0.output.LayerNorm.weight')[D]=g_out[0]; get(pre+'0.output.LayerNorm.bias')[D]=0
        # layers 1..10 protect
        for l in range(1,11):
            p=f'{pre}{l}.'
            for k in ['query','key','value']:
                get(p+f'attention.self.{k}.weight')[:,D]=0
            get(p+'attention.output.dense.weight')[D,:]=0; get(p+'attention.output.dense.bias')[D]=0
            get(p+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')[D]=g_attn[l]; get(p+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')[D]=0
            get(p+'intermediate.dense.weight')[:,D]=0
            get(p+'output.dense.weight')[D,:]=0; get(p+'output.dense.bias')[D]=0
            get(p+'output.LayerNorm.weight')[D]=g_out[l]; get(p+'output.LayerNorm.bias')[D]=0
    # final layer readout
    p=pre+'11.'
    E[p+'attention.self.query.weight']=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.query.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.value.weight']=np.eye(768,dtype=np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.value.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.dense.weight']=(c*np.eye(768)).astype(np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.dense.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight']=np.ones(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'output.dense.weight']=np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32)
    E[p+'output.dense.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'output.LayerNorm.weight']=np.ones(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'output.LayerNorm.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    if save:
        for n,a in E.items(): save_edit(n, a.astype(np.float32))
    return E, N
'''
open('builder.py','w').write(builder)
exec(builder)
